mechanism: Carbamazepine induces CYP3A4, potentially increasing amphotericin B metabolism; amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity which may affect carbamazepine clearance and increase CNS toxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function closely, carbamazepine levels, and CNS symptoms; consider alternative antifungal if possible; adjust carbamazepine dosing based on levels and renal status.
